summary: Well-executed, preregistered paired study that measures the marginal effect of adding a deterministic verifier+one repair iteration to an LLM intent→configuration pipeline under a shared-initial-candidate design. Execution and archival appear complete and well-documented. The experiment reveals a ceiling-effect regime (baseline 499/500, guarded 500/500) so the measured verifier benefit on the preregistered pass-rate metric is numerically small; statistical reporting and artifact hashes are present. Recommended clarifying revisions (resolvable from archived artifacts) would improve transparency and interpretability but the underlying study is scientifically sound.
required_revisions: Enumerate exactly which verifier-modeled properties and severity classifications (the preregistered property set) were used to produce the binary pass/fail label; include the mapping from specific violation codes to 'high'/'medium' severity. This must reference the archived validator traces or the validator specification artifact.

Report the stratified task-allocation counts (number of tasks per cluster: VLAN-change, ACL-change, static-route-change) from the preregistered task_manifest and confirm no tasks were excluded; add the explicit counts to Methods/Results.

Provide the exact identifier(s) of the single discordant pair (task_id and pair_id) and the archival retrieval path(s) (artifact file and byte/record index or an unambiguous lookup instruction) and state the corresponding artifact SHA-256 so reviewers can inspect the per-task validator diagnostics and repair trace.

Add a brief clarification in Methods/Results explaining the interpretation limits created by the preregistered 'shared_initial_candidate' generation_semantics: explicitly state that the comparison isolates verifier+repair conditional on the same initial model proposal and therefore does not measure potential gains from verifier-guided regeneration or larger repair budgets.

Add a short explanatory sentence about the exact McNemar two-sided implementation and why the reported p = 1.00 occurs for the observed discordant-pair counts (n10=1, n01=0), referencing the analysis artifact that implements the exact test.
optional_revisions: Include a short (1–2 paragraph) qualitative excerpt of the repair prompt/response for the discordant pair as a supplementary inline excerpt (the artifact exists) to illustrate the failure mode and repair behavior.
Report latency distribution summary (median, IQR) per task for guarded vs baseline (the execution logs contain timestamps).

Expand Related Work briefly with any directly adjacent recent published integrations of LLM agents with deterministic verifiers (if present in the archived literature record) to strengthen positioning.
